verdict_reason: AlphaEarth confirmed real (2017-2024 annual, CC-BY 4.0, GEE-hosted; 2020 baseline exists). But no real declared EUDR supplier polygons for soy/cattle are publicly obtainable: the Art.33 Information System is restricted to competent-authority checks per fetched EC pages; Trase gives aggregated trade flows, not operator plots. Candidate must simulate the polygons it claims to screen.
